paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.22% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+0.83%) and FTSE 100 weakest (-1.14%). Brent crude changed -0.32% to 104.43. Gold changed -0.79% to 3,938.3. Bitcoin changed +1.49% to 77,817.8438. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.952%, a relative move of +1.19%. Among the firms tracked, Apollo (-4.95%) and Vale (-3.17%) moved the most.
